implementation_verdict: validated — moves with the published factor
verdict: decayed — the published factor is also flat over this window, so this agrees with the literature rather than contradicting the paper
caveats: Universe is survivor-biased: only currently-listed large caps. The delisted losers momentum would have shorted are structurally absent, which biases this test against the paper's result.
Sample is 2006-02-28..2026-09-30, not the paper's 1964-1989. This is a different experiment, not a refutation.
80 names versus all of NYSE/AMEX in the original, so deciles here are far coarser.
Costs charged at 10 bps on turnover; the paper reported gross.
Prices are Yahoo adjusted closes, which are adjusted retroactively.
